name: Huntington Commons
summary: Huntington Commons is a community shopping center in Huntington, NY, anchored by ShopRite and featuring value-oriented retailers like Marshalls, Old Navy, and Petco. This convenient one-stop destination serves local families with groceries, discounted shopping, dining, fitness, and essential services.
demographics: Huntington Commons serves a diverse suburban Long Island demographic, primarily attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the Huntington area. The trade area draws heavily from households with annual incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, with a strong representation of families with children and established homeowners. Shoppers typically visit for weekly grocery runs at ShopRite combined with value-oriented shopping at Marshalls and Old Navy, reflecting a practical, budget-conscious consumer base that values convenience and one-stop shopping for everyday needs.
description: Huntington Commons is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 839 New York Avenue in the heart of Huntington, New York. This essential retail destination has become a cornerstone of the local community by offering a comprehensive mix of everyday necessities and value-oriented shopping options. The center is anchored by ShopRite supermarket and features popular national retailers including Marshalls for discounted fashion finds, Old Navy for affordable family apparel, and Petco for pet supplies. Beyond its retail offerings, Huntington Commons provides convenient services such as 24 Laundromat, Eden Nail Spa, and dining options like New China Restaurant, along with specialty shops like Bee's Arts and Craft Studio and New Chapter Apparel. With its practical tenant mix focusing on groceries, fitness, quick-service dining, and everyday shopping needs, Huntington Commons has established itself as an indispensable one-stop destination for Long Island families seeking value and convenience in their daily shopping routines.
